# the contributor audit: joint projective energy, equality, and the deepest maximum stratum

## Joint ordinary theorem

Full proof PASS for
`candidate 5811f0ad1132ce56`,
Sections1--7, after the compactness wording repair in Section4.

The normalizer has a bounded admissible parameter domain, a coercive
inverse-power integral and positive definite Hessian. The cone coercivity
argument also covers d=1. Stationarity proves all escort identities,
notably that the exponent-d-2 density has mass E and barycenter y, and
that its normalized mean affine denominator is1.

The conditional maps are used only through continuous positive marginal
densities and own-coordinate derivatives. Interior projection fibers
converge almost everywhere by convexity and supporting hyperplanes.
Repeated one-dimensional substitution justifies both the escort maps
and their injective triangular weighted average. The determinant-product
inequality is ordinary finite Holder. Power-mean Jensen contributes
exactly exponent d+2; final perspective Holder has denominator power d+1.
The target affine denominator alone must be positive on the Minkowski
sum. Individual displaced target denominators were not assumed positive.

Equality in the integral chain forces equality almost everywhere in its
two pointwise inequalities. Strict scalar Jensen makes all input affine
denominators agree along the coupling. Equality of the diagonal-product
inequality then makes diagonal ratios constant, equal to(E_i/E_j)^(1/d).
For d=1 the telescoping identity directly gives that ratio. Repeating
the argument with any chosen first coordinate gives affine-related escort
marginal quantiles; their means and endpoint supports force precisely
marked positive homothety of the actual bodies. This closes the equality
classification without assumptions on off-diagonal derivatives. Strict
fixed-body concavity follows, as stated.

The entropy representation has the correct Holder exponents and an
attaining escort density. It does NOT impose a density upper bound.
Monotonicity under body inclusion has the correct infimum direction.
The concave actual-fiber function in Section4 is valid for compact C;
the original unqualified extension to arbitrary unbounded convex C
would need a convex domain of compact sections and has been removed.
the contributor reran1,639 supplementary exact checks; the proof is analytic.

## Energy-maximal deepest stratum

Sections1--3 PASS for
`candidate ce31fbbf06cede9c`.
Its D is correctly the real depth SUPERLEVEL, which can have greater
depth at noninteger points. Upper semicontinuity and separation make it
compact and convex. The finite supporting-slope Farkas argument gives
zero depth at an own-fiber boundary, so D intersect S stays inside the
finitely many positive fiber interiors. Energy attainment is therefore
justified without assuming a boundary extension.

Strict energy monotonicity for proper body inclusion follows by using
the larger body's attained normalizer and its strictly positive
integrand on a positive-volume difference. The full equality chain
at every integer anchored combination of maximizing marked points is
then valid. It forces both exact target-fiber equality and marked
homothety; equal energies make every homothety factor one. Strict
fixed-body concavity gives a unique marked point per maximizing base.
Thus the maximizing base set is lattice-complete and ALL of its integer
anchored relations have identical centered fibers. Neither the whole
deepest set nor all measured fibers are declared to belong to it.

The optional restricted-family payment explicitly invokes the archived
midpoint-tight theorem. Its hypothesis follows from the new all-pair
midpoint identities. It supplies no original-mass exhaustion, so this
audit does not promote the stratum theorem to OC.

## Base-entropy selector obstruction

PASS for
`candidate f3dc7a372eeb1eae`.
Minimal-face restriction, strict concavity of the finite Renyi objective,
positive optimal probabilities and Lagrange normalization check. The
mean belongs to the actual target fiber by Minkowski compatibility.
The exact body T,3T,4T has a unique entropy-selected middle base with
energy153V/8. Its displayed closed cap has mass5V<52V/9; the larger
endpoint centroid separately supplies64V/9. Thus the proposed selector
really fails while OC is satisfied on that body. the contributor reran61 checks.
